load_coco_json: load a COCO instances annotation JSON file into Detectron2 standard dataset dict format
load_sem_seg: load semantic segmentation ground truth images paired with input images by matching file paths
convert_to_coco_json: convert a Detectron2 registered dataset into COCO JSON format and cache it to a file
register_coco_instances: register a COCO-format dataset with DatasetCatalog and MetadataCatalog for instance detection and segmentation
run_coco_data_vis: run the module CLI to load COCO annotations and visualize them as annotated images
